import re, subprocess, os, itertools

os.chdir('/app')

# Build synonym families from synonyms.txt
families = []  # list of lists of words
with open('synonyms.txt') as f:
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        words = [w.strip() for w in line.split(',')]
        families.append(words)

# Map: word -> (family_index, is_first/original)
word_family = {}
for i, fam in enumerate(families):
    for j, w in enumerate(fam):
        word_family[w] = (i, j == 0)

# Build regex over all family words (lowercase, word boundaries)
all_words = sorted(word_family.keys(), key=len, reverse=True)
# Case-insensitive pattern; capture groups for order
pattern = re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z])(' + '|'.join(re.escape(w) for w in all_words) + r')(?![A-Za-z])', re.IGNORECASE)

text = open('input.tex').read()

# Find all matches with positions
matches = pattern.findall(text)  # list of matched strings
positions = [(m.start(), m.end(), m.group(0)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
print("total matches:", len(positions))

# Group occurrences by family
from collections import defaultdict
fam_occurrences = defaultdict(list)  # fam
